row.name: Power Integrations Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=37 breakdowns=8 bursts_in_base=5 giveback=1.95 tightness=1.15 base_volume_vs_leg=0.95 base_volume_vs_avg=0.99
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 37 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 8 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 1.95 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -4.8% vs its 20-SMA, -16.1% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The consolidation box spans 37 sessions with 8 recorded 4%-down breakdowns and 5 bursts inside it — the chart shows a prolonged, choppy, declining base from ~$55 down to ~$38 with wide overlapping bars and repeated failed rallies, which is the opposite of the tight, orderly consolidation Bonde requires. The base gave back 1.95x the prior leg gain and ranged wider than the leg itself, confirming visually what the FAIL records. The burst bar itself opened with a large gap down (~4.4%) from the prior close and then recovered, meaning much of the 12.5% bar range is gap-dominated and the net close-to-close gain is only 4.2% on a day that started sharply lower.
claude.key_risk: The base is a multi-month declining channel with repeated breakdowns, not a consolidation — any follow-through faces the full weight of overhead supply from $42 to $56.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst day's close of $41.40 or if the stock gaps up more than 1% above it without holding, given the heavy overhead supply and weak base structure.
